founders.label: The Founder
founders.title: A company led
founders.subtitle: Orbexa Systems is a boutique firm where the founder is the one who designs, develops and delivers every project. No management layers, no delegation to juniors, no surprises.
founders.story: After 15+ years working on software projects for major corporations — banking, insurance, telecommunications and retail — I realized something: most SMBs and growing businesses don't have access to that level of technical expertise. Large consultancies are expensive, slow and put their best talent on their biggest accounts. I founded Orbexa Systems to change that: bringing enterprise-level engineering to any business, with direct service, agility and total transparency.

faq.label: FAQ
faq.title: Everything you need
faq.subtitle: I answer the most common questions before you start your project.

items.question: How much does it cost to develop a project?
items.answer: Every project is unique, so I don't have fixed prices. The cost depends on the scope, complexity and estimated time. What I can guarantee is full transparency: in the free consultation I analyze your needs and deliver a detailed proposal with no commitment.

items.question: How long does a project take?
items.answer: It depends on the type of solution. A landing page can be ready in 1-2 weeks. A web application with custom features takes 1 to 3 months. More complex platforms or integrations may take longer. I always define clear timelines before we start.

items.question: Do you work with startups or only large companies?
items.answer: Both. I have experience in enterprise environments in banking, insurance and telecommunications, but I also support entrepreneurs and growing businesses. I adapt the solution and budget to the stage your business is at.

items.question: What if I don't like the result?
items.answer: I work with iterative deliveries every 2 weeks so you can see and validate progress constantly. This eliminates surprises at the end. I also include a 30-day warranty after final delivery to fix any functional bugs at no additional cost.

items.question: Do I need to know about technology to hire you?
items.answer: No. You describe the business problem you want to solve and I handle the technical solution. My job is to translate your needs into technology, not the other way around. You just need to know your goal — I choose the path.

items.question: Do you work remotely?
items.answer: Yes, I operate 100% remotely with clients in Mexico and abroad. I use collaboration tools to stay aligned: weekly video calls, real-time project boards and demonstrable deliveries every sprint.

items.question: Do you provide support after delivering the project?
items.answer: Yes. Every project includes a 30-day warranty for bug fixes. I also offer maintenance and ongoing support plans for those who need monitoring, updates and post-launch technical assistance. Emergency support is available 24/7.
